verdict.rationale: Scoped credentials are a fair question for an agent framework, but the evidence pack never shows smolagents issuing scoped or least-privilege API credentials for an agent. The import allowlist (`additional_authorized_imports`) and sandboxed execution limit what code can run and where. Neither is credential issuance, so both are adjacent controls and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
